text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.title: Endpoem Settings
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.acc: When disabled, all End Poem packets are blocked locally on this client. This also blocks the normal vanilla End Poem.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.use: When enabled, the client reads End Poem text from config/endpoemfabric/end.txt. Edit the file, then reopen the End Poem to apply it.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.edi: Open the built-in editor or the custom End Poem text file.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.sho: Show or hide Minecraft's vanilla credits after the End Poem. Title-screen credits are unchanged.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.cus: Cycle in timeline order: Off, Before Poem, Inside Poem, After Poem, or After Vanilla. After Poem is before vanilla credits; After Vanilla is skipped when vanilla credits are hidden.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.credits_pl: Inside-poem insertion point; click to select an exact paragraph boundary.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.edi: Add, edit, remove, and reorder contributors. Editing the list does not enable custom credits playback.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.bac: Left changes the background; right toggles dark corners.
The left button changes image fitting. The right button crops the selected percentage from each edge.
Name the image background. PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, and GIF (first frame) are supported; then click Reload.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.status.bac: No supported background image was found or read; using the vanilla background
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.scr: Adjust the End Poem's automatic scroll speed.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.per: Sets the operator permission level (0–4) required to use /endpoem. Only level-4 operators can change it.
text.endpoemfabric.editor.title: Custom End Poem
text.endpoemfabric.editor.plain_text.des: Editable: § is shown as plain text.
text.endpoemfabric.editor.preview_read_o: Preview mode is read-only. Legacy § formatting is applied.
text.endpoemfabric.credits_editor.title: Custom Credits
text.endpoemfabric.credits_editor.name: Contributor Name
text.endpoemfabric.credits_editor.empty: The list is empty. Click Add to create a contributor.
text.endpoemfabric.credits_editor.load_f: The credits file could not be read; the original file was not changed
text.endpoemfabric.credits_editor.name_r: Contributor name is required in entry %s
text.endpoemfabric.credits_editor.invali: The credits contain invalid or overlong content
text.endpoemfabric.credits_editor.discar: Your changes to the contributor list will be lost.
text.endpoemfabric.credits_placement.ins: Choose a paragraph; custom credits will be inserted after it
text.endpoemfabric.credits_placement.una: The poem needs at least two non-empty paragraphs
text.endpoemfabric.credits_placement.loa: The active End Poem could not be read
text.endpoemfabric.credits_placement.row: Paragraph %s, %s, custom credits will be inserted after this paragraph
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.option.bac: Choose the music played during the End Poem.
Place music.ogg (Vorbis), music.wav, or music.mp3 in the music folder.
text.autoconfig.endpoemfabric.status.mus: No supported custom music was found; using vanilla End Poem music
